issues.desc: background.md Solution Tradeoffs section uses the claim 'B-7813 already reconciles plan.md on the declare-unreachable path' to justify excluding plan.md DoneWhen/Verify general drift from this story's scope. Code inspection (packages/main/src/handlers/stall-adjudication.ts withdrawUnreachableChecklistItem, packages/main/src/handlers/proofstory.ts scope_shrinkage_decision_set ~L926-1005) shows the declare_unreachable path only withdraws checklist items and a separate ProofStoryAcceptanceBinding contract artifact (types.ts ~L2626, referencing checklistRefs/verificationIntentRefs/milestoneIds) -- no code path rewrites the literal plan.md markdown file's DoneWhen/Verify prose. B-7813's own background.md uses the same loose framing ('force plan.md/claims to reconcile'), so this may be an accepted paraphrase, but a reader relying on this scope-exclusion rationale could wrongly assume plan.md text itself gets mechanically corrected after a withdrawal, when only checklist.json/proofstory.json metadata is updated.

background.md Trigger Event / Key Insights use the abbreviation 'M1' ('reuse M1's re-attestation once M1 exists. M1 shipped as B-ec67...') without ever spelling out what M1 stands for (Milestone 1 / tool-executed evidence receipts per docs/evidence-integrity-program-spec.md L39-42). A fresh reader without that external spec can infer M1 is some prior milestone tied to enforceAndStampEvidence/VerificationExecutionReceipt from the parenthetical, but the letter-number code itself is never expanded inline, unlike the cross-story references (B-1507/B-3b88) which do get one-clause explanations.
